Every top-level value here renders exit 0 under `quarto render` 1.7.33, so the
feature must produce ZERO diagnostics: `toc: True` (valid boolean spelling),
`number-sections: false`, `df-print: "kable"` (quoted enum member), `cache:
refresh` (enum whose members include booleans — `refresh` is a valid member),
`documentclass: myclass` (OPEN), `format: html`, `title:` (free string).

The last three are the NULL-ARM lock (document-key plan §2.5, prerequisite P).
Their schemas list a literal `null` enum member (`auto-play-media` =
`enum:[null,true,false]`, `ipynb-shell-interactivity` = `enum:[null,"all",…]`),
which `valuesOfSchema` DROPS from `values` while `closednessOfSchema` still marks
the field CLOSED — so before the `acceptsNull` fix the matcher flagged all three,
a cardinal-sin false positive. Each is grounded exit 0 single-valued, and the four
YAML null spellings are covered across them (`null`, `~`, `NULL`; `Null` is unit-
tested). The case-inexact `NuLl` and the quoted `"null"` are quarto-REJECTED and
belong in the INVALID fixture, not here.
